tasks.target: Attack the complete actual signed tenth-moment target through coefficient-sensitive high values. Derive a new arithmetic estimate, not the generic coefficient-uniform Gram bound. The actual positive r2 coefficients and prescribed displaced radius window must be used before generic absolute estimates. A precise failure identifies the first missing actual inequality and its full deficit. Read only supplied context; exact primary sources may be consulted when necessary. Stop after report.

Only assigned report may be written; no shared state or successor edits.

tasks.target: Attack the complete actual K10 through signed fifth rational convolution or equivalent shifted shell correlations. If no gain, isolate a precise complete residual estimate with costs and explain why a suggested cancellation fails; distinguish actual obstruction from upper-method costs. No broad literature sweep needed. Stop after report.
